title: Pan2023
description: A cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 14 healthy participants who performed cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery on two separate days. EEG was recorded from 28 channels at 250 Hz. The dataset supports research on cross-session decoding and brain-computer interface (BCI) development.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier (28 channels, 10-10 montage, nose reference, 250 Hz sampling). Each session had four blocks of 30 trials (15 left, 15 right, random order). Each 7 s trial had a 1 s 'Ready' cue, a 4 s motor imagery period with a left- or right-handed rowing game animation and sound, and a 2 s rest.
